title: Murphy's Camping on the Ocean

services.name: Rental Units
services.desc: Our brand new geodesic domes are now available for booking! Built to withstand the wild Atlantic elements, these frameless, all-weather domes invite you to stargaze from bed, sip coffee above crashing waves, and settle in by the warmth of your private woodstove. Whether it’s a foggy morning or a starry night, these domes are at the very heart of the Wild Islands Coast. We’re introducing our first seaside cottage for the 2025 season! Located on our new property adjacent to the campground, this cottage is available for the 2025 season, offering a 3-piece bathroom, kitchen, queen size bed, and pull-out sofa, sleeping a maximum of 4 people.
